Captain Tsubasa.name: Captain Tsubasa
Captain Tsubasa.summary: Captain Tsubasa for Mega-CD is an entry in the soccer-RPG hybrid series based on the manga and anime of the same name. As with other entries in the series, actions during soccer games are selected from an RPG-style menu and animated in dramatic fashion.

Sonic CD.name: Sonic CD
Sonic CD.summary: A fast-paced platformer that follows Sonic as he races through time-traveling zones to rescue past and future versions of stages and stop Dr. Robotnik’s time-altering plans. Combining classic Sonic speed and precision with CD-quality music, animated cutscenes, and branching time-based routes, it rewards quick reflexes and exploration to unlock true endings.
